note: Extra English search words for Eurostat tables whose catalogue title is too generic for the words a question is searched with ('Simplified energy balances' shares only 'energy' with 'energy supply by source and final consumption by sector'). l5geo.rs adds a table's words once to its catalogue text (the S signal: title twice, these words, folder path); a table with no entry ranks as without the file. Each entry says only what the table holds: dims are dimensions the table has in the metabase (checked by the real-catalogue test), and the words name no number and no place.
